title: University ownership as a moderator: the impact of human security of academic staff on job retention
core_idea: Investigate the relationship between dimensions of human security for academic staff and their job retention in Jordanian universities, and test whether university ownership (public vs private) moderates that relationship.
tldr: This study uses a cross-sectional online survey of academic staff in Jordanian public and private universities (n=356) and structural equation modelling to examine how human security relates to job retention and whether university ownership moderates that relationship.
